description: Chapter 1 - heatmap. Weekly use (%) of each online audio service by year (Infinite Dial). Shared encoding: x = year, y = service; darker orange = more people.

data.description: Load the merged CSV (data/australian_radio_data.csv), which holds every dataset used on the page.

transform.description: Keep the 'weekly online audio service usage' rows.
Compare each year with the year before (lag) to build the change text for the tooltip.
transform.calculate: isValid(datum.last_year) ? (datum.value - datum.last_year >= 0 ? '+' : '') + (datum.value - datum.last_year) + ' points' : 'First year measured'

transform.description: Short change label for the cell (blank in the first year).
transform.calculate: isValid(datum.last_year) ? (datum.value - datum.last_year > 0 ? '▲' + (datum.value - datum.last_year) : datum.value - datum.last_year < 0 ? '▼' + abs(datum.value - datum.last_year) : 'no change') : ''

layer.description: Coloured cells: orange sequential scale for % of people.
Percentage printed in each cell; white text only on the darkest cells (Spotify), near-black otherwise.
Annotation: change from the year before, under each value (e.g. Apple Music ▲6 in 2025).
